source._comment: Oklahoma State Election Board posts county x party absentee PDFs on its Absentee Voting Statistics page only in an election's final stretch (for the 2024 general: from Oct 29). ok_update.py takes the newest 2026 'ballot-totals-by-affiliation' (mail: sent/undeliverable/received) and 'absentee-inperson-totals' (in-person early) files and uses them only if the election date printed in the file is election_date, so primary/runoff files are ignored. Parser verified against the 2024 general mail report and the Aug 2026 runoff in-person report.
